```json
 "topology": "nmos_diffpair_pmos_mirror + pmos_CS + inverter",
 "rationale": "NMOS pair (VCM 0.9 V leaves ~0.3 V for the tail) with a short-L PMOS mirror load. Stage-1 gain stays moderate (~10), so the out1 time constant C/gds is short. The PMOS CS stage has a gate-voltage replica of the diode and a 3:1 current ratio, giving systematic balance and gain ~15. The inverter makes the output rail-to-rail and gives correct polarity. Budget at IREF≈5 uA: ref 5 + tail 5 + CS 7.5 = 17.5 uA, about 31.5 uW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":   (2.0, 1.0, 8.0),     # input pair W [um]
    "L_in":   (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "W_ld":   (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),   # PMOS mirror-load W [um] (per device)
    "L_ld":   (0.2, 0.15, 0.5),    # short L -> moderate stage-1 gain, fast pole
    "W_mir":  (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),     # NMOS mirror unit W [um]
    "L_mir":  (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "m_tail": (2, 1, 4),           # tail fingers (ref has 2)
    "m_s2":   (3, 2, 6),           # stage-2 sink fingers
    "W_invn": (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),
    "W_invp": (3.0, 1.0, 10.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    m_ref = 2
    m_tail = max(1, int(round(p["m_tail"])))
    m_s2 = max(1, int(round(p["m_s2"])))
    i_tail = iref * m_tail / m_ref
    i_s2 = iref * m_s2 / m_ref
    # CS PMOS width keeps current density equal to the diode -> systematic balance
    W_cs = p["W_ld"] * (i_s2 / (i_tail / 2))

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias mirror
    n.M("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_mir"] * m_ref, p["L_mir"], m=m_ref)
    n.M("MT",  "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_mir"] * m_tail, p["L_mir"], m=m_tail)
    # preamp: vinp -> diode side, vinn -> output side (out1 rises when vinp>vinn)
    n.M("M1", "d1",   "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], p["L_in"])
    n.M("M2", "out1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], p["L_in"])
    n.M("M3", "d1",   "d1",   "vdd",  "vdd", "pfet", p["W_ld"], p["L_ld"])
    n.M("M4", "out1", "d1",   "vdd",  "vdd", "pfet", p["W_ld"], p["L_ld"])
    # gain stage: PMOS CS (out1 up -> out2 down), NMOS sink
    n.M("M5", "out2", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_cs, p["L_ld"])
    n.M("M6", "out2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_mir"] * m_s2, p["L_mir"], m=m_s2)
    # inverter: out2 down -> vout up
    n.M("M7", "vout", "out2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_invn"], 0.15)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "out2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_invp"], 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    id1 = i_tail / 2
    vs = 0.3
    try:
        o1 = lut.op("n", p["W_in"], p["L_in"], vcm_g := 0.9 - vs, 0.7, vsb=vs)
        gm1 = o1["gm"] * (id1 / max(o1["Id"], 1e-12)); gds2 = o1["gds"] * (id1 / max(o1["Id"], 1e-12))
    except Exception:
        gm1 = 14 * id1; gds2 = gm1 / 60
    gm4 = 10 * id1
    a_p = 8 + 60 * (p["L_ld"] - 0.15) / 0.35
    gds4 = gm4 / a_p
    g1 = gds2 + gds4
    A1 = gm1 / g1
    gm5 = 10 * i_s2
    gds5 = gm5 / a_p
    gds6 = 10 * i_s2 / 120
    A2 = gm5 / (gds5 + gds6)
    cox = 8e-15  # F/um^2
    c1 = cox * (W_cs * p["L_ld"] * 0.7 + p["W_ld"] * p["L_ld"] * 0.3) + 0.3e-15 * A2 * W_cs + 2e-15
    t1 = (c1 / g1) * math.log(2)
    c2 = cox * 0.15 * (p["W_invn"] + p["W_invp"]) + 3e-15
    t2 = c2 * 0.9 / i_s2
    i_inv = 25e-6 * p["W_invn"]
    t3 = cl * 0.9 / i_inv
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = vdd * (iref + i_tail + i_s2)
    offset = 0.002
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": offset, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "A1": A1, "A2": A2, "gain_tot_vod": A1 * A2 * vod}
```
